author: Hola
body:
English.

Experience: The first avicus tourney (3rd). T5-11 and 3 mini events on OCN, BiaB (4th), HoC (4th), AoA (9th), BttC2 (9th). 

Pretty good comms

Fine with any position. 

Above average at cannons not that it matters though.

Strong at bow, average at sword

Timezone is GMT+2.

Looking for a team that has the potential to go far next tournament

If interested please add me on Skype, it's mclyyris.
